BOOT_NUXEL.method: adb reboot -> SSH kernel identity + systemd running + regulator_force_enable in kallsyms
BOOT_NUXEL.uncertainty: none (kernel build timestamp 00:43:30 matches clean build)

KERNEL_PATCH_INTEGRITY.method: clean case-sensitive build, deterministic patch apply + reverse-check

REGULATOR_CORE_SAFETY.method: source audit + regression test + read-only live check (no WARN_ON)
REGULATOR_CORE_SAFETY.uncertainty: none for open_count invariant; always_on bypass is the narrow intended recovery path

POWER_DOMAIN_IDENTITY.uncertainty: sensor-hub vs GNSS domain separation is source-derived; no datasheet confirmation

ROM_ENDPOINT_IDENTITY.uncertainty: live endpoint identity not confirmed (no GPS_PWR_EN assertion)

VENDOR_SEQUENCE.method: stock kernel source call-graph + gpsd-ownership inference
VENDOR_SEQUENCE.uncertainty: GPS_PWR_EN rise->ROM-ready delay absent from tree (datasheet/gpsd disassembly needed)

GPIO_OWNERSHIP.uncertainty: none for physical pin identity (gpg0-2, not gpg4)

POWER_TRANSITION_SAFETY.method: no GPS_PWR_EN assertion; no new regulator transition (read-only validation only)
POWER_TRANSITION_SAFETY.uncertainty: vendor post-power timing + RF-safety evidence missing; requires separate owner approval

DOWNLOADER_OFFLINE.method: nuxel_bbd_flash --rom-probe / --flash exclusive; ROM probe never writes firmware
DOWNLOADER_OFFLINE.uncertainty: none (offline; no firmware download performed this stage)

SYSTEM_INTEGRITY.method: dtb/dtbo/recovery digests unchanged (TWRP readback) + 0 failed systemd units

readiness.blocking_reason: The two remaining gates require the separately-authorized GPS_PWR_EN (S0->S1) physical assertion, which needs vendor-sequence/datasheet evidence and owner sign-off.  The BOOT-flash mandate (which this mission completed) does NOT authorize that assertion.
